# Laura

Laura is a workspace that gives agents an **API over the UI**, so agents can tile panes while pair-programming, in a web browser or the terminal.

## Docs

- [Tutorial](https://thomaseleff.github.io/laura-tui/content/tutorial.md): A step-by-step walkthrough for users.
- [Use the workspace](https://thomaseleff.github.io/laura-tui/content/workspace.md): How to start Laura, review files, and show a web page in a browser pane with the agent's browser tools, for users.
- [Navigating the workspace](https://thomaseleff.github.io/laura-tui/content/navigation.md): The keystrokes, clicks, pane header, status bar and file rendering in the workspace, for users.
- [Navigating the TUI](https://thomaseleff.github.io/laura-tui/content/tui-navigation.md): What is different when Laura runs in the terminal (`laura --tui`), for users.
- [Agent reference](https://thomaseleff.github.io/laura-tui/content/agent-reference.md): Common usage reference for the `laura` CLI for agents.
- [CLI reference](https://thomaseleff.github.io/laura-tui/content/cli.md): Complete reference of the `laura` CLI commands and flags for agents.
- [Protocol](https://thomaseleff.github.io/laura-tui/content/protocol.md): How tiling and interactions work across processes for agents.
